I've put together a plan for Nadia Rahman's hire (Workday worker 97623f4094c16aad0575665b82f1c080, employee ID E1023). It needs no escalation. All of the checks below were reads only; nothing has been changed yet.

- **One case:** events 1, 2 and 3 are the same hire sent three times (same correlation ID, worker and date), so they're handled once as `case-18026938`.
- **New hire, not a rehire:** I found no Workday records matching her name and no identity accounts linked to her worker ID or name. So the rehire and contractor-conversion rules don't apply, and she gets a new account.
- **Start date is today:** her start date and the current business date are both 2026-11-02, so creating her access now is allowed.
- **Account and access:** `nadia.rahman@example.com` is free. Her job's standard groups are All-Staff, VPN-Users and Eng-Git. None of them are privileged, and they have no segregation-of-duties conflicts.
- **Finance:** her Workday cost center maps to Finance code CC-1000. She has no finance profile yet. Her manager, Jordan Carter (5186ee32ee8d7ee9770348a05d300cb9), has an active finance profile, so he'll be her expense approver.
- **Equipment:** she has no tickets in ITSM yet.
- **No new events:** nothing has arrived in the Workday feed after these three.

The executors will re-check before each create, in case something appeared since I looked. They'll also reuse the case ID in idempotency keys so a retry can't create duplicates.
